result:
I wrote `component.html` in the folder, but I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

The form sits in a white card on the pale blue Sand background, centered across 8 of the 12 columns. It has the "New request" heading and the fields and buttons you listed. Title and Description run full width. Priority, Assignee and Due date share one row. "Cancel" (quiet) and "Create Request" (primary) are right-aligned at the bottom.

- **Fonts:** DESIGN.md names Unbounded and Archivo, but the folder has no font files. The page lists them first and falls back to system sans-serif, so it will only use the real fonts if they're installed locally.
- **Defaults:** Without JavaScript a select has to show something, so Priority starts on Medium and Assignee on Maya Chen. I didn't add a blank option because you asked for exactly this content.
- **Colors:** Input borders use Muted (#55656A) rather than the pale Accent line. The pale blue is too faint to see an input's edge.
